author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the play style of the second character in Season Pass 5, Robo-Ky, in this trailer for Guilty Gear Strive, an action fighting game developed by Arc System Works. Players can soon gain access to a new playable character with the Season Pass 5 as Robo-Ky takes to the fight. Robo-Ky is scheduled to be released on July 2, 2026, with Season Pass 5 of Guilty Gear Strive on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Guilty Gear Strive - Official Robo-Ky Character Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at action-packed gameplay from DarkSwarm in this trailer for the upcoming online co-op, top-down tactical shooter game. Play as a team of elite operators in procedurally generated, semi-destructible levels. Use your skills, wits, and teamwork to destroy the alien DarkSwarm in daring operations deep inside the infested colonies. DarkSwarm will be available in Steam Early Access.
title: DarkSwarm - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Ironfields, a single-player tactical RTS game developed by 
Divis Studio. The game features retro-styled combat focused on capturing and defending existing map structures instead of traditional base building. Ironfields is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC (Steam).
title: Ironfields - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Demo launch trailer for Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver, a chill, narrative adventure game developed by WhaleFood Games. Hop aboard your cosmic sailboat and seek out folks in need of help in this storybook universe! Investigate, trade items, and explore the galaxy in a chilled-out adventure. Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solve is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC (Steam).
title: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Adhain, a god simulator and city builder game developed by Little Wormhole. Your power is limited to the areas where people believe in you, win over new villages to expand your influence. Yet, your creature is the exception to this rule, starting out young and inexperienced, it learns by observing you, your villagers, and even other creatures. Train it well, and it becomes a true extension of your power, able to cast miracles and act in areas where you can’t. Become the god you want to be and bring the land under your control - whether through kindness or fear. Adhain is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Adhain - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Bikinis, Beaches, and… Penguins? Check out the latest Goddess of Victory: Nikke trailer for the sci-fi RPG shooter game to see what's coming with the summer update, which brings summer character variants, exclusive gacha and stylish pass costumes, a remote island narrative event, and a beachside arcade-style mini-game. The Summer Update for Goddess of Victory: Nikke will be available on PC and mobile devices on July 2, 2026.

The new story event ‘Wave to You’ begins when the Commander receives a mysterious package containing an old photograph and a ticket to South Burst Island. Accompanied by Cinderella, what begins as a summer getaway turns into an unexpected adventure as secrets hidden beneath the island begin to emerge. Waiting beneath the waves is a fearsome new boss encounter featuring a variant of the Land Eater that has transformed into an entire island lurking beneath the ocean floor.
title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke - Official Summer Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a peek at the next collaboration coming to the Goddess of Victory: Nikke in this latest teaser for the sci-fi RPG shooter game. The teaser trailer showcases hints from Persona 5, Persona 4, and Persona 3. More details about the true form of this collaboration will be revealed soon. Goddess of Victory: Nikke is available on PC and mobile.
title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke x Persona - Official Collaboration Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Pre Order Trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, an upcoming 2D anime action fighting game based on the hit Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. Players will duke it out in action-packed battles with favorites from Team Avatar and The Legend of Korra, with key features such as rollback netcode, crossplay, and more for modern hardware. Seek victory in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, launching on July 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.
